summary: WeRide Inc. filed a Form 6-K attaching a Hong Kong Next Day Disclosure Return disclosing a share repurchase. On 18 May 2026, the company repurchased 540,000 WVR ordinary shares on the Nasdaq at US$2.3283 per share, representing 0.057% of then-outstanding shares. The repurchased shares are held as treasury shares. The board confirms authorization and compliance with listing rules. This is a routine capital return to shareholders via open-market buyback; no change in total issued shares occurred. Watch for ongoing repurchase activity to gauge management's view on undervaluation.
